game_title: Cipher Decoder – Supply Cache Camp Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp, a high supply cache: the summit pilot must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Cipher Decoder: Shift characters using ord/chr operations to decode secret notes.
theme: Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp: a high supply cache
core_gameplay_loop: In Supply Cache Camp, repeat each round: Shift characters using ord/chr operations to decode secret notes. Each round, ice hawks strike the summit beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the decoded value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from ice hawks in Supply Cache Camp: keep the decoded meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: decoded drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Cipher Decoder
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
